What is a Digital Product Passport?

This passport provides a structured digital record for the remanufactured transmission, covering identity, provenance, component disposition, remanufacturing operations, testing, environmental impact, fitting requirements, warranty, and end-of-life options.

What You Can See

  • Original core and vehicle fitment information
  • Remanufacturing and component disposition records
  • Dyno, hydraulic, valve-body, and pressure test results
  • Material reuse, circularity, and estimated carbon impact
  • Fitting, warranty, support, and core-return instructions

Why It Matters

  • Helps customers verify the unit and fitting requirements
  • Supports repair, reuse, remanufacturing, and core return workflows
  • Keeps product data available from first scan through end of life

Remanufacturing

Component disposition, operations, and test records.

Remanufactured - tested and ready for exchange supply

Processes Applied

  • Core identification and serial traceability
  • Full strip-down, degreasing, cleaning, and inspection
  • Case, gearset, shaft, drum, and valve-body condition assessment
  • Replacement of friction plates, steels, seals, bushes, bearings, filter, pan, and wear items where required
  • Torque converter remanufacturing, balancing, and leak checking
  • Hydraulic circuit and valve-body bench testing
  • Dyno road-test simulation where appropriate
  • Final inspection, DPP record update, and dispatch

Lifecycle

Installation, warranty, support, and end-of-life information.

Dyno tested PASS Road-test simulation
Warranty Up to 36 mo Subject to terms
Core loop Return Inspection-based credit

Installation Guidance

  • Fill with approved ATF using the correct temperature-controlled fill procedure before road use.
  • Flush or replace oil cooler lines and confirm the cooling circuit is clear before installation.
  • Complete adaptation reset/programming where required, then perform a controlled road test with oil temperature and shift quality monitored.

Torque Specifications

Torque converter bolts 45 Nm Confirm OEM sequence and thread-locking requirements
Crossmember mounting bolts 55 Nm Use manufacturer-specific setting for vehicle
Oil pan fasteners 10 Nm Tighten evenly to avoid pan distortion

Handling Warnings

  • Do not fit before resolving oil cooler contamination or overheating faults
  • Do not use unapproved ATF or skip fill-level temperature checks
  • Do not drive before completing required programming or adaptation procedures

Warranty

Up to 3 years parts and labour warranty subject to Mackie sale, fitting, oil, programming, and returns requirements.

Warranty support requires correct fitting, approved ATF, oil cooler and line cleaning or replacement where required, adaptation/programming procedures, and a completed installation record. Overheating, contamination, incorrect oil, abuse, and unrelated vehicle faults are excluded.

End of Life

Mackie transmission core return and inspection process

Contact Mackie with transmission references, vehicle details, fault information, and photos. Drain ATF and package the core securely before return.

Indicative core credit: GBP 250.00
